newsitem.title: USA: Fresh America Wal-Mart business curtailed.
newsitem.headline: Fresh America Wal-Mart business curtailed.

text.p: Fresh America Corp said Friday that an option on a distribution agreement it had with a Wal-Mart unit will not be exercised.

The company said that Sam's Club, a division of Wal-Mart Stores Inc, advised it that as a result of the opening of its new Wal-Mart Supercenter Distribution Center in Winter Haven, Florida, it will not exercise the existing option under the agreement to distribute produce directly to 40 Clubs.

It is expected that the transition will occur in March and April. Fresh America believes that the distribution of those 40 Clubs by Sam's Club will not have a material adverse effect on its results of operations.

The company said that revenues and contributions from recently aanounced acquisitions and new business as well as increased volumes from other distribution customers will more than offset the reduction in revenues and contributions from these 40 Clubs.

Separately, the company announced it executed a definitive agreement to purchase the assets of CPT Enterprises, a specialty distribution company with existing operations in Los Angeles and San Francisco.
The company had previously announced that it had signed a letter of intent.
